players.product: AI / HPC data-center campuses on owned powered land (Hannibal campus with pending Long Ridge, Matagorda County TX; developed with Starwood) plus Exaion sovereign private cloud for AI inference in Europe

quarterly_data.signal: MARA 8-K (Item 1.01 and press release): on July 2, 2026 a MARA subsidiary acquired MAT 1177 LLC from HIF USA, holding rights to land in Matagorda County, Texas and rights under a letter agreement with an electric utility relating to 2,000 megawatts of power capacity. The site is expected to provide access to up to an initial 1 GW of grid capacity by October 2027 and up to 2 GW by April 2028, has already received interest from potential HPC tenants, and will be developed through MARA's partnership with Starwood Digital Ventures as a digital infrastructure campus for high-performance computing workloads and flexible compute including Bitcoin mining; phased construction is expected to begin in 2026, contingent upon regulatory approvals. CEO Fred Thiel: 'we believe sites with access to reliable, scalable power will become increasingly valuable.'
quarterly_data.figure: 2,000 MW utility letter agreement; up to 1 GW by October 2027, up to 2 GW by April 2028
